title: FlowTwin v0.3 taxonomy-coherent TCN-physics development candidate

development_dataset.test_status: opened development set; never eligible for confirmatory evidence

model_contract.physics_branch: persistence-skip nominal observer plus route-gated V/Q P&ID transport
model_contract.class_anomaly_hierarchy: fault partition is serialized from TargetContract.code_is_fault; summed fault-class probability equals anomaly probability
model_contract.ood_score: log1p mean normalized observer residual squared plus log1p route-active transport error; not numerically interchangeable with v0.2 energy

training_budget.training_window_sampler: deterministic event-aware plus timeline-spanning selection using train labels only; every train episode containing a non-N00 target row must retain at least one such row
training_budget.class_balance: shared exhaustive train-only population, each row counted once with eval_mask; inverse-square-root frequency, mean-normalized and clipped to [0.25,4]
training_budget.evaluation_windows: exhaustive; every row exactly once through eval_mask

critical_delay_gate.eligible_rows: valid_mask & eval_mask & measured_flow_l_h > 1 & observable route gate > 0
critical_delay_gate.valid_rows: eligible rows where local window index - V/Q/dt >= 0

post_hoc_design_disclosure.statement: The thresholds and window 96 were selected after inspecting D2 and are development-only.

calibration.probability_policy: validation-only binary-fault and conditional-class temperature scaling preserving the taxonomy hierarchy

alarm_policy.no_operating_point_policy: fail before any test iterator is constructed

future_confirmatory_gate: Any paper claim requires a newly generated, independently sealed profile set whose test partition has not been inspected during model, window, alarm, or threshold design.
claim_boundary: Synthetic development experiment only. It cannot establish field accuracy, pasteurization efficacy, HACCP conformity, safe-product status, release authorization, or superiority on unseen external data.
